reading.title: Pluto Stations Amid Sextiles
overview: The Sun at 22° Libra in fall forms a tight sextile to Jupiter in Leo while the Moon in Sagittarius runs out of bounds and applies to a trine with that same Jupiter. Mercury sits in Scorpio, Venus is retrograde in its detriment, and Mars in Leo holds a close trine to Saturn retrograde in Aries. Pluto stations direct out of bounds in Aquarius, with Neptune and Uranus also retrograde, producing a Neptune-Pluto sextile and Uranus-Pluto trine.

Mundane tradition reads the Sun-Jupiter contact as measured diplomatic or legislative movement, the Mars-Saturn trine as attrition and hardened positions, and the outer-planet aspects as slow structural shifts in collective belief and power. The last New Moon at 17° Libra fell in the eleventh house for the United States and the sixth for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, placing emphasis on alliances and armed forces respectively.
No positions or aspects are invented; all statements rest on the listed placements, orbs under 2° where noted for national angles, and the whole-sign house placements of the recent lunation.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC and squares natal Venus while Jupiter sextiles natal Mars. These contacts coincide with reporting on US economic posture in the hemisphere and delays in federal programs, yet the fair-test records show no reliable link between such Neptune transits and measurable events.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Saturn squares natal Uranus. The lunation fell in the sixth house with Mars in the fourth. Reporting on Russian strikes in Kyiv overlaps with the listed Mars-Saturn and Uranus-Pluto aspects, though the same records find Mars afflictions no better than chance for air-raid activity.

Neptune squares the natal Sun while Jupiter trines the MC and Uranus trines natal Saturn. The lunation occupied the sixth house. These placements sit near coverage of European reactions to diplomatic signals, without any demonstrated predictive edge in the tested data.

Pluto conjoins the natal Moon and ASC while Neptune sextiles both. The lunation fell in the fourth house. Reporting on PLA aircraft activity near Taiwan aligns with the listed Venus-Mars square and Uranus-Pluto trine, yet the records show no consistent signal from these configurations.

reading.lore_and_intel: Sun sextile Jupiter, Mars trine Saturn, Neptune sextile Pluto, Uranus trine Pluto, Venus square Pluto and Uranus sextile Neptune each overlap listed reporting on European reactions to diplomatic shifts, counter-drone technology, Middle East strikes, Afghan resistance, LA program delays, art-gaming boundaries, hypersonic developments and Taiwan air activity; the same aspects show no overlap with the tested records on personnel losses, rocket alerts or earthquakes, which remain indistinguishable from chance.

watch.note: Sun enters Scorpio, shifting emphasis to the Scorpio stellium and eighth-house matters for several capitals.
Full Moon at 3° Taurus, to be watched against the same national houses and tested indicators.
New Moon at 17° Scorpio, repeating the Scorpio emphasis of the prior lunation.

reading.the_test: The compiled records show Mars afflictions, retrograde stations, full moons and eclipses perform no better than chance against Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israeli alerts, Russian losses and worldwide magnitude-6+ earthquakes across thousands of days. All listed p-values exceed 0.05 after correction, confirming the outcomes match random expectation.
